name: TVM weekly AI report (upload week, Azure OpenAI narrative, HTML download)

parameters.completionMessage: Your TVM weekly report is downloading.

parameters.content:
## Weekly AI report (upload the week's files -> HTML)

Upload all of a week's daily `tvm-overdue` Excel files; download an HTML report with an
AI-written summary plus a per-owner table.

**Flow:** n8n parses every file and computes all the numbers (start/end counts, net change,
new / cleared / overdue-all-week tickets). Azure OpenAI only writes the prose from those
numbers, so figures never drift.

**Setup (one-time)**
- On the **Azure OpenAI Chat Model** node: pick your Azure AI Foundry credential, enter the
  Project, and select your chat deployment (e.g. gpt-4o). Needs an Azure OpenAI deployment.
- The two AI nodes are LangChain nodes; if either shows as unrecognized on import, delete and
  re-add it from the node panel (search "Azure OpenAI Chat Model" and "Basic LLM Chain") and
  reconnect.

**Use**
1. Open "On form submission", copy the form URL (run via the form, not Execute step).
2. Upload the week's files; download `tvm-weekly-report-<start>-to-<end>.html`.

**Notes**
- Needs files from the tvm-overdue workflows (columns "Overdue Tickets" and "Assignment")
  with the date in each filename.
- If the report shows only one day, the multi-file parse didn't tag dates — open "Parse files"
  output and confirm multiple files came through.
